title: Yantian: Shenzhen's Gem of History, Nature & Slow Living
description: Discover Yantian, Shenzhen’s tranquil coastal district steeped in Neolithic history, Lingnan Hakka culture, and serene beaches. Escape the city’s hustle with Liye Jiang to explore misty mountains, migratory bird havens, and a life where time slows by the sea.
